title: Data Migration Specialist (Syniti) - Remote (Richmond, IN, US, 47374)
description:
Innovation Starts With You
Propel your career at Belden, where innovation creates possibilities-for our people, our customers, and the communities we serve. We connect people, information, and ideas to solve the world’s most complex connectivity challenges, turning curiosity into meaningful impact. Here, you’ll take on work that challenges you, supports your growth, and empowers you to shape what’s next. You’ll collaborate with global teams, gain diverse perspectives, and contribute to solutions that extend beyond our business-creating value in the world around us.
Together, we are shaping the future of digitization and paving the way for the next generation of innovation.
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled SAP Data Migration expert with extensive experience in SAP data migration projects with previous experience on Syniti tools (ADM or ADMM). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP data models and migration processes, coupled with the ability to interact with cross-functional teams, ensure data quality, and deliver on project timelines.
Key Responsibilities

• Participate in end-to-end data migration projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and SAP implementation strategies.

• Configure data migration tools including Syniti ADMM and BODS for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes, ensuring accurate and efficient data migration.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to define data mapping and migration requirements, scope, and timelines.

• Develop and implement data migration plans, including data cleansing, validation, and reconciliation processes.

• Conduct data profiling and analysis to assess data quality and identify issues prior to migration.

• Coordinate with technical teams to design and optimize data migration processes and workflows.

• Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards throughout the migration process.

Required Experience & Skills

• 8+ years of experience in SAP data migration roles for greenfield or brownfield projects. Expertise on data migration methodology (mock cycles, validation approach, etc.) is a must.

• Proven experience with data migration tools including LTMC, DMC, BODS, Syniti tools (e.g., Syniti ADMM/SKP, Syniti Knowledge Platform) and its various modules including Reporting hub, Migrate & Construct.

• Experience with legacy SAP data tools like LSMW, MASS, etc.

• Strong understanding of SAP modules and data structures (e.g., S/4HANA, ECC).

• Extensive knowledge on SAP Data model (Materials, Business Partners, BOMs, Routings, etc.)

• Knowledge on configurable materials and associated data objects including material classes and characteristics.

• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with a focus on data quality and integrity.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

• SAP certification in one or more technical areas is a plus.

• Certification on Syniti ADMM would be preferred.

• Exposure to Variant Configuration (VC or AVC) would be a plus

title: AWS Solutions Architect
description:
AWS Solutions Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AWS Solutions Architect
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type : Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range : $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced AWS Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate large-scale, secure, and highly available cloud platforms on Amazon Web Services. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role spanning architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security, observability, and continuous operational improvement of mission-critical production workloads. The successful candidate will bring strong working knowledge of the AWS service portfolio, deep DevOps fundamentals, and a pragmatic, cost-aware design mindset, and will partner with application, security, and SRE teams to deliver resilient, cloud-native solutions that scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Architect, deploy, and operate enterprise-grade AWS environments across compute, networking, storage, identity, and managed data services, with strong attention to scalability, reliability, and security.

• Author and maintain production-quality infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK, with rigorous version control, peer review, and automated validation.

• Design multi-account AWS organizations, including landing zones, SCPs, centralized logging, and shared services, to support secure and scalable enterprise adoption.

• Build secure VPC topologies - including subnetting, route tables, transit gateways, VPN, and Direct Connect integrations - that meet enterprise connectivity and isolation requirements.

• Implement strong IAM strategies using roles, permission boundaries, SCPs, AWS SSO, and short-lived credentials to enforce least-privilege access across the organization.

• Design, deploy, and operate Amazon EKS clusters and other container platforms (ECS, Fargate), including auto-scaling, networking, and integration with service meshes and observability stacks.

• Operate AWS managed data and analytics services such as RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, S3, Redshift, Glue, and Kinesis, optimizing each for the access patterns and SLAs of the workloads it supports.

• Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI, enabling repeatable, audited deployments of both infrastructure and applications.

• Implement comprehensive observability using CloudWatch, X-Ray, AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and third-party tooling, with well-designed dashboards, alerts, and SLOs.

• Drive ongoing cost optimization through right-sizing, savings plans, reserved instances, lifecycle policies, and architectural simplification, with measurable savings tracked over time.

• Implement disaster-recovery and business-continuity capabilities, including cross-region replication, automated backups, regular failover testing, and documented runbooks.

• Strengthen security posture using AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Macie, Inspector, Config, and CloudTrail, and lead remediation of findings in collaboration with security teams.

• Advise application development teams on AWS-native design patterns, anti-patterns, and the appropriate service choices for each problem domain.

• Develop automation scripts and operational tooling in Python, Bash, and Go to streamline routine work and accelerate incident response.

title: Remote Quality Improvement Specialist
description:
Who We Are
Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.
We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.
Who You Are
You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.
Your Role
As a Quality Improvement Specialist with Evergreen Nephrology , you are responsible for serving as the connector between patients, provider practices, and internal teams to identify, manage, and close quality gaps through targeted education, consistent outreach, and data driven collaboration. The Quality Improvement Specialist manages a defined patient and provider panel, delivers actionable performance insights, and drives improvement across HEDIS and Medicare Stars measures using payer specific specifications, timelines and attribution logic. The ideal candidate is effective across patient engagement, provider coaching, workflow optimization, and cross functional teamwork, and is comfortable operating in a fast pace, performance-oriented value-based care environment.
Role Responsibilities

•
Provider Engagement, Quality Education & Measure Performance

• Serve as a trusted partner to nephrology and primary or specialty practices on HEDIS and Stars expectations, documentation standards, and Evergreen’s value-based care priorities.

• Share and interpret quality reports, care gap lists, and dashboards, translating performance data into clear, practical improvement steps that align with Evergreen’s workflows and practice capabilities.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

- Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.

- Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

THE MODULAR TEAM

The Modular team is building factory-produced modular data centers, taking them from released drawings to rate production on our Phoenix manufacturing line.

- Close the loop to design: feed what the line learns back into one-lines, panel schedules, and the BOM, keeping the drawing set the single source of truth

About JerseySTEM

All JerseySTEM roles are pro-bono (unpaid) positions.
Areas of Focus - Azure Hosting & Administration, AWS Infrastructure, Migration, Cloud Governance

•
AWS Infrastructure Operations: Design, maintain, and support secure AWS environments across compute, storage, networking, account structure, and operational practices that complement JerseySTEM ’s Azure-hosted services.

•
Azure Hosting & Administration: Administer Azure-hosted applications, data services, and supporting infrastructure, including tenant configuration, subscriptions, resource groups, access controls, monitoring, and core service settings.

•
Infrastructure as Code: Implement and maintain AWS infrastructure using repeatable, version-controlled practices with tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to improve consistency, reliability, and speed of deployment.

•
Hosting Migration & Platform Integration: Support the migration from legacy hosting environments onto hyper scalers, coordinating application hosting, data warehouse hosting, identity integration, networking, and operational handoff.

•
Identity & Access Operations: Oversee practical identity and access controls across Azure and AWS, including role design, permission management, account lifecycle processes, and secure access standards.

•
Reliability & Service Continuity: Establish backup, monitoring, logging, and recovery practices across cloud services to support service continuity and operational resilience.

•
Cost & Resource Optimization: Monitor Azure subscriptions, licensing, hosted services, and AWS usage to identify waste, improve efficiency, and recommend right-sized solutions aligned to a nonprofit budget.

•
Governance & Standards: Define lightweight cloud standards, documentation, and operational guardrails that enable volunteer contributors to manage AWS and Azure responsibly and consistently.

Overview
Membership is a minimum six-month commitment of approximately 6-8 flexible hours per week and includes a $100 refundable deposit, returned after six months of active membership. K-12 educators, retirees, veterans, interns, and students are exempt from the deposit. Members contribute their professional skills and leverage their networks in service of the organization’s gender-equity agenda.
Role Overview Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) or designated technology leader, the Cloud Infrastructure Lead is a high-impact role for an experienced professional who can translate organizational needs into a secure, stable, and well-governed cloud operating model. The role focuses on strengthening JerseySTEM ’s Azure hosting, administration, data services, and tenant operations while maintaining AWS as a complementary infrastructure platform for applications, internal systems, and future migration needs.
This role blends hands-on implementation with tactical oversight across Azure administration, AWS infrastructure, migration planning, automation, integrations, and lightweight governance suited to a remote, nonprofit environment.

• 8+ years of proven experience in cloud infrastructure, Azure administration, AWS operations, platform engineering, or systems engineering roles.

• Strong understanding of Azure hosting, tenant configuration, subscription management, user lifecycle management, and AWS infrastructure concepts including compute, storage, networking, IAM, backup, and recovery.

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or equivalent.

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge - navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remote rs working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you
This is an exciting time to join Remote as a Senior Product Manager, Payroll , an IC role for someone with genuinely high technical depth - trading management scope for depth. You'll partner with your Engineering Team Lead and Staff Engineers on architecture and technical direction as a peer, not an observer, forming your own technical opinions and prototyping to answer questions rather than scheduling a meeting about them.
Your mission is to own your product area end to end: not just the software, but the full experience customers and internal teams get from it, including the API surface other teams and integrators build on.
What you bring

•
Technical Direction: Partner with the Engineering Team Lead and Staff Engineers on architecture, design quality, and technical direction. Form independent, well-reasoned technical opinions and hold your own in design reviews as a peer.

•
Build to Learn: Prototype and write code to de-risk ideas, answer open questions, or ship small pieces yourself rather than defaulting to a meeting.

•
API & Integration Quality: Own products where APIs are the product surface. Design contracts, guide versioning and backwards compatibility, and own the developer experience for teams and systems integrating with your product.

•
Root Cause Problem-Solving: Sit with the specialists and ops teams doing the manual work, observe real workflows, and prioritize based on where the pain actually is. When systems disagree, fix the underlying cause rather than building a better reconciliation report.

•
End-to-End Ownership: Own adoption and hypercare, not just delivery - including whether what you shipped is actually being used months later.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with payroll and tax experts on research and requirements, convene across teams, and onboard others into context generously.

•
Clear Communication: Document decisions and reasoning in writing (specs, Looms, proposals) so your thinking is inspectable and can be challenged.

Key Responsibilities

• Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code is required. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code/prototypes, not just write specs.

• Experience as product manager in a high-growth company

• Experience working in payroll, HR, benefits, fintech, or similar

• Great judgment making both strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions

• Demonstrable, self-driven results that have moved a product in the right direction

• A strong sense of product design (UX)

• A passion for products that just work, even if the problems they solve are boring and complicated

• Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements

• Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English

• Bonus: experience working remotely

title: Supply Chain Delivery Manager, Data Center Power & Cooling OFE
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

•
About the Role

Anthropic is bringing data center capacity online faster than the industry has ever attempted, and the owner-furnished equipment (OFE) that makes a site live - switchgear, transformers, UPS, generators, busway, PDUs, chillers, CDUs, air handlers, dry coolers, pumps and piping skids - is long-lead, high-value, and sits squarely on the construction critical path. When a transformer slips three weeks at the factory, a data hall slips three weeks at the site.

We're hiring a Supply Chain Delivery Manager to own that equipment from purchase order to dock. You will be the site-facing supply chain lead for a regional portfolio of data center projects: tracking every OFE line item against the construction schedule, running factory and logistics escalations with OEMs, holding suppliers and general contractors accountable for delivery performance, and giving leadership a clear, converged picture of delivery risk across the portfolio. Your job is to make sure equipment production and delivery are never the reason a site misses its ready-for-service date.

This is a senior individual-contributor role on the Compute DC Infrastructure team, working daily with Construction, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, Commissioning, and our general contractors and OEMs. It is not a category-management or negotiation role - Sourcing owns supplier strategy and commercial terms - and it is not a people-management role. The emphasis is execution: schedules, escalations, logistics, and site readiness.

What You'll Do

Delivery planning and schedule integration

•
Own the end-to-end OFE delivery plan for each site in your portfolio: order placement, engineering submittal/approval milestones, production slots, FAT dates, ship dates, and required-on-site (ROS) dates, integrated with the GC's construction schedule.

•
Engage during preconstruction with Construction, Engineering, and the GC to set OFE delivery expectations, sequence equipment arrivals to the build, and identify schedule risk before POs are cut.

•
Lead OFE kickoff meetings at the site level with the GC and internal construction teams, establishing points of contact, delivery windows, receiving requirements, and escalation paths.

•
Maintain the single source of truth for OFE status across the portfolio - a live tracker of every line item, its milestone dates, and its risk rating.

Supplier execution and escalation

•
Run weekly delivery cadences with OEMs and integrators on open orders; verify production progress against committed slots rather than accepting reported dates at face value.

•
Act as the primary escalation point for factory slips, component shortages, FAT failures, and shipping delays; drive recovery plans (expedites, partial ships, resequencing, alternate sources) with Sourcing and Engineering.

•
Partner with Sourcing on corporate-level supplier escalations, bringing site-level schedule intelligence to commercial conversations.

•
Hold GC OFCI teams accountable for receiving, storage, and installation-readiness performance; manage the change/claim process when delivery issues affect the GC's schedule.

Logistics and site readiness

•
Plan and coordinate transportation for oversize/overweight and high-value equipment - carrier selection, route surveys, permits, crane and rigging coordination - with our logistics partners and the GC.

•
Manage laydown, staging, and interim storage decisions when site readiness and equipment arrival diverge; coordinate with Quality and Commissioning on receiving inspection and storage/preservation requirements.

•
Ensure equipment arrives complete - accessories, spares, doc

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you’ll do:

• Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You’ll be great for this role if you:

• Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly

• Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns

• Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case

• Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns

• Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable - fintech, payments, or similar domains

• Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge

• Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

• Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift

• Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike

• Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly

• Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

title: Senior Estimator – Civil / Road Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian business supplying road safety barriers - for roadsides, car parks, schools and other sites - to councils, contractors and construction clients across Australia. The business is led by its General Manager and Operations Manager, who this role reports to directly.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently run the day-to-day estimating and quoting workflow - checking plans against the schedule, taking off quantities, sourcing supplier pricing and working out margins - and to build the kind of trust with management, through accurate work, honest communication and a focus on keeping the client happy, that lets the role take on more of the client-facing side over time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

• A senior, full-time Estimator role at the centre of the quoting process - reviewing customer enquiries, checking supplied plans against the job schedule, and turning that into an accurate, priced quote using the company's own templates and rates.

• Internally, one person currently runs estimating end to end, from enquiry through to submitting the quote to the client. Remotely, this role owns the estimating and quoting engine room - checking plans, sourcing supplier pricing, working out margins and building the quote - while management keeps final client sign-off and quote submission in-house at the start.

• As trust builds over the first few months, there is scope for this role to take on more direct client contact. This is not a sales role, and no commercial decision is made without management's sign-off.

• Trusted to work independently on the estimating and quoting workflow and exercise judgement on scope and pricing questions within agreed rates - but genuinely understanding an instruction, plan or piece of feedback, and asking a clarifying question rather than guessing or agreeing by default, matters more in this role than in most.

• Keeping the client happy sits behind every part of this role - even while quote submission stays with management at the start, the accuracy, turnaround and professionalism of the work behind the scenes is what keeps the client relationship strong.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

▸ Enquiries & Plan Review

• Review new customer enquiries and the plans or drawings supplied for the job

• Check the supplied plans against the job schedule to confirm they match, and flag any differences before quoting rather than assuming

• Request missing photos, information or clarification from management rather than guessing

▸ Takeoffs & Quote Preparation

• Perform takeoffs from civil/road design drawings using Adobe for markup and measurement

• Record and tally quantities in Excel, and build the quote using the company's templates, pricing structure and rates

• Own quote accuracy and turnaround time on the estimating side, with minimal supervision

▸ Pricing & Supplier Coordination

• Source and compare pricing from a couple of different suppliers for each job

• Chase, confirm and follow up outstanding supplier pricing

• Work out margins and the final cost to the business before the quote goes to management

▸ Client Communication (Phased)

• In the early months, prepare the quote for management to review and issue to the client directly - client-facing communication and quote submission stay in-house at the start

• Communicate with suppliers directly as required, using the company's official email

• Flag anything a client mentions that could be a new opportunity back to management, even though this is not a sales role

• Over time, and only as agreed with management, take on more direct client contact - by email first, and potentially by phone later

▸ Communication & Judgement

• Ask a clarifying question rather than guessing or agreeing to an instruction, plan or piece of feedback that isn't fully understood - the single most important trait for this role

• Communicate clearly and accurately in written and spoken English with management and suppliers

• Escalate only genuine exception

• Solid grasp of CTS concepts and the ability to design clocks to meet timing requirements.

• Working knowledge of IR-drop optimization strategies.

• Experience with timing closure and ECO implementation (PT-ECO or Tweaker experience is an asset).

• Strong scripting skills.

• Exposure to several of the following: synthesis, StarRC, PT DMSA, RedHawk, Calibre, and formal verification (LEC or Formality).

• A track record as a self-starter who also works well within a team.

Remote Work

title: Mid-Level Software Engineer – C#
description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live ’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.
THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our C# and .NET services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.
RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Ship features. Build and maintain services in ASP.NET Core, from a scoped design through code review to production.

•
Write tests that hold. Cover your code with xUnit so regressions show up in CI, not in production.

•
Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Datadog dashboards to trace bugs to root cause.

•
Work within our data layer. Write efficient Entity Framework Core queries and migrations that don't lock production tables.

•
Handle messaging and background work. Build and monitor jobs on RabbitMQ or Kafka.

•
Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.

•
Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

• 2-4 years building production software, with at least 1-2 years in C# and .NET.

• Comfortable building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.

• Solid grasp of xUnit (or NUnit) and test-driven development.

• Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, and relational databases.

• Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Exposure to RabbitMQ, Kafka, or other messaging systems.

• Familiarity with Redis or Azure services.

• Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

• You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.

• A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.

• Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.

• High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

•
Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.

•
Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.

•
Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.

•
Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

•
AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.

•
Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.

•
Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code
